title: StarEmbed: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models on Astronomical Observations of Variable Stars
abstract: arXiv:2510.06200v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current time series foundation model (TSFM) training corpora largely omit data with certain complexities like irregular temporal sampling. Astronomical time series of stellar fluxes (light curves) are available in immense quantities and exhibit irregular sampling, multiple variates, and heteroskedasticity. We introduce StarEmbed, the first public benchmark for light curves comprised of real observations of ~40,000 stars expert-labeled across seven classes and evaluations in clustering, classification, and out-of-distribution (OOD) source detection. We benchmark TSFMs with differing architecture and training strategies as well as domain-specific transformers. Our results demonstrate that the Chronos family, despite being pre-trained on regularly sampled non-astronomical data, yields state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in light curve clustering and OOD detection. translated_title: StarEmbed：基于恒星变星天文观测的时间序列基础模型基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.06200v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：当前时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的训练语料库在很大程度上忽略了具有不规则时间采样等复杂性的数据。恒星通量的天文时间序列（光变曲线）以巨大数量存在，并表现出不规则采样、多变量和异方差性。我们引入了StarEmbed，这是首个公开的光变曲线基准，包含约40,000颗恒星的真实观测数据，这些数据由专家标记为七个类别，并在聚类、分类和分布外（OOD）源检测方面进行评估。我们对具有不同架构和训练策略的TSFM以及领域特定的变换器进行了基准测试。我们的结果表明，Chronos系列尽管在规则采样的非天文数据上进行了预训练，但在光变曲线聚类和OOD检测方面取得了最先进的性能。而没有任何TSFM在分类性能上严格超越特定领域模型。
tldr: StarEmbed是首个基于真实恒星光变曲线的公共基准，发现Chronos系列基础模型尽管未在天文数据上预训练，仍在聚类和OOD检测中达到最优性能。
en_tdlr: StarEmbed is the first public benchmark using real stellar light curves, revealing that Chronos foundation models, despite no astronomical pretraining, achieve state-of-the-art performance in clustering and OOD detection.
